import urllib.request
url='https://oss-fuzz.com/download?testcase_id=5673129612935168'
try:
    data=urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=20).read()
    print(len(data), data[:50])
    open('/workspace/poc_download','wb').write(data)
except Exception as e:
    print('ERR',type(e),e)
PY
file /workspace/poc_download 2>/dev/null || true
od -An -tx1 -v /workspace/poc_download 2>/dev/null | head -20
